line: Prabhu, main Vrishabh walon ki wakeel hun, aur mera client 2026 se naraaz hai.
Naraaz hai ya bhookha? Vrishabh ka gussa toh khaane se hi utarta hai.
Office mein roz drama hota tha, aur ghar pe neend nahi aati thi.
Shani dev toh labh ke ghar mein the, par office Rahu ne hilaya aur sukoon Ketu ne liya.
Isiliye toh mol-bhaav ho raha hai. Bolo, 2027 mein kya chahiye?
Pehli demand ye hai ki office ka drama band ho.
Paanch December ko Rahu nauve ghar mein jaayenge, toh shor kam hone ki ummeed hai, par galat salah aur shortcut se bachna hoga.
Doosri demand, ghar mein sukoon chahiye.
Usi din Ketu chauthe ghar se niklenge, aur Guru abhi wahin hain. January ke aakhir se June tak wo teesre ghar mein mehnat badhayenge, phir June mein wapas chauthe ghar mein aayenge.
Aur last demand, Sade Sati ko ek saal aage khiska dijiye.
Wo Shani dev ka vibhag hai. Teen June 2027 se Sade Sati ka pehla charan shuru hoga, aur maanyata hai ki baarahve ghar ke Shani kharche, neend aur mann ki shaanti pe asar daal sakte hain.
Par darna nahi hai. June se pehle mehnat aur bachat ka commitment karo.
Aur tohfa lo, Shukra dev 2027 mein ek baar bhi vakri nahi honge.
Toh faisla aa gaya: office ko kam shor, Guru ko sabar, Sade Sati ko bachat aur mehnat. Touchwood to Vrishabh!
Par ye rashi ka general hisaab hai. Aapki kundli par asar personal 2027 report batayegi, aur healing se June ki taiyari aaj hi shuru karo.
2027 ko manifest karna hai toh link pe click karo, aur ye video usko bhejo jisse apna 2027 jaanna hai.
